name: Restoran 010 — Perakende POS karosu açılır
description: Demo Restoran (010) Restoran kabuğunda Perakende karosu RestPOS satış ekranını açar.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the RetailEX login page
Connect tenant retailex_demo if needed, then sign in as admin / admin
Select firm Demo Restoran (010), pick a store if needed, and enter the app
Open the top shell module labeled Restoran
If Günü başlat is visible, click it to start the day
Click the dashboard tile labeled Perakende
Verify the restaurant retail POS screen is active with product categories or a cart area suitable for retail sales
